registration_note: REGISTERED AT step 29,650/30,000 — i.e. BEFORE the 30k checkpoint existed and before any 30k number could be seen. That timing is the point: a threshold chosen after seeing the number is a garden of forking paths (GATE_PROTOCOL 0.3). No threshold below is new: every kill bar is carried forward VERBATIM from the pre-registered flagship-v4.card.json (registered 2026-07-22, before the v4 line launched). The only additions are (a) the co-primary, entered as REPORT-ONLY for the reason in co_primary.report_only_rationale, and (b) provenance stamps required by 0.7/0.8.
primary_role_note: DEMOTED per GATE_PROTOCOL 0.2. ade_0_2s is proposal-quality: E1a measured that on the SAME 43 windows the paired ADE@2s delta is 0.0109 [-0.0, 0.0312] NOT SEPARATED while corridor departure goes 0.0035 -> 0.5877. It is read and recorded; it does not adjudicate alone.
goal_provenance_note: GATE_PROTOCOL 0.8. MODE B structurally requires route/route_graded/vt_band minted from the ego's OWN FUTURE poses (eval_flagship_v4.py:140-141), so the primary is goal-oracle-fed. THREE channels, not four: vt_speed is overwritten with the observed v0 (eval_flagship_v4.py:78). MEASURED size of the privilege on this arm at 15k: oracle 0.5839 -> produced 0.7577, paired delta +0.1738 [+0.1247, +0.2356] SEPARATED; oracle beats CV separated (-0.2538) while PRODUCED DOES NOT (-0.0800, CI spans 0). REQUIRED: render oracle (the only surface comparable to the 10k/15k history), then re-render --goal-mode produced on the SAME checkpoint and report the PAIR. Do NOT transplant +0.1738 — the goal head is still training; measure the gap AT 30k. The verdict may NOT be worded as a deployed-capability claim.

co_primary.report_only_rationale: This is the FIRST gate to carry the co-primary, and NO kill threshold for it has ever been agreed. Inventing one 41 minutes before the number lands would be exactly the forking-paths failure 0.3 forbids — and the two errors it could cause are asymmetric: a bar set too tight kills a healthy arm, a bar set too loose launders a bad one. So at THIS gate the co-primary is MEASURED, REPORTED IN FULL (overall + junction + peak XTE + OOD ratio), and used to SET the bar for the next gate against a real baseline. It does NOT enter the kill conjunction here. Reference points already MEASURED on REF-C base: overall 0.5877 [0.5107, 0.6622], junction 0.8414 [0.8144, 0.8667], peak XTE 38.94 m.
co_primary.becomes_kill_criterion_at: the next v4-line gate, with a threshold registered from this gate's measurement

secondary_void.reason: The strategic route TARGET is a lookup of the route INPUT (refb_labels.route_target = _NAV_TO_ROUTE[nav_cmd]), so training route-CE reaches EXACTLY 0.0 by ~step 14.5k and route_skill is 0.0 BY CONSTRUCTION; the follow-head answers straight 240/240. MEASURED 2026-07-26: route_target == _NAV_TO_ROUTE[nav_cmd] on 100.00% of CE-eligible windows under v1, v2 AND v2.1 — the command is minted from the same route_from_future* call as the target, so NO LABELER SWAP CAN BREAK IT. The metric measures the label bug, not the model. It MUST be printed in the verdict: a suppressed criterion that is not printed is indistinguishable from one that passed.
secondary_void.re_arms_when: an arm trains with real route supervision (--labels-v21 --v2-route-from-vision), at which point it becomes meaningful again and returns to the kill set
